content.title: 'Daredevil: Born Again' Season 2 Release Schedule: When Do New Episodes Come Out?
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Season 2 of Daredevil: Born Again premieres on Disney+ on March 24After that, new episodes will be released weekly on TuesdaysA companion podcast will also be released alongside each episode Daredevil: Born Again is back! The Disney+ series — which is a reboot of the Netflix series Daredevil that ran from 2015 to 2018 — returns for season 2 on March 24. It picks up nearly a year after its debut season's shocking ending, which saw Kingpin/Wilson Fisk (Vincent D’Onofrio) essentially take control of New York City. In addition to D'Onofrio, Charlie Cox returns as Matt Murdock, along with their costars Jon Bernthal, Wilson Bethel, Elden Henson and Deborah Ann Woll. They will be joined by newcomer Matthew Lillard and Krysten Ritter, who is reprising her role from Jessica Jones. Several months ahead of the premiere, Cox told Screen Rant that although he had only read six of the eight episodes of season 2, it's "some of my favorite stuff I've read of Daredevil." Here's everything to know about the release schedule for Daredevil: Born Again season 2. When does Daredevil: Born Again season 2 premiere? Krysten Ritter in 'Daredevil: Born Again.'. Courtesy of Marvel Television Mark your calendar! Daredevil: Born Again season 2 returns on March 24, 2026, nearly a year after fans were left with a shocking twist in the season 1 finale. "The ... oddly emotionally satisfying thing about that conclusion, is that the good guys lost. Matt Murdock lost. Fisk won," Daredevil: Born Again director Justin Benson told Comicbookmovie.com following the April 2025 season 1 finale. "There’s something beautiful about them being, ‘Yeah, we lost. There’s not a lot of hope, but we’re going to have the grit to ... keep going.' " How many episodes are in Daredevil: Born Again season 2? Charlie Cox in 'Daredevil: Born Again' season 1. Disney+/Marvel Studios /Courtesy Everett Collection There are eight episodes in Daredevil: Born Again's second season, followed by a special presentation episode known as, "The Punisher: One Last Kill," starring Bernthal. Series director Aaron Moorhead told Comicbookmovie.com that season 2 will begin with Daredevil and Kingpin fully embracing their alter egos instead of trying to hide them. "They’ve both pulled off their masks. 'I am Daredevil, I am Kingpin.' We’re just going to be those things," he said. "So, as we begin season 2, we get to see what that’s like as they feel fully self-actualized." What is the Daredevil: Born Again episode release schedule? Charlie Cox and Deborah Ann Woll in 'Daredevil: Born Again'. Jojo Whilden/Marvel The first episode of Daredevil: Born Again's second season premieres on March 24. After that, new episodes will be released every Tuesday until the season finale on May 5, followed by a special presentation episode. Related Stories Here's the full episode release schedule: March 24: "The Northern Star"March 31: "Shoot the Moon" and "The Scales & the Sword"April 7: "Gloves Off"April 14: "The Grand Design"April 21: "Requiem"April 28: "The Hateful Darkness"May 5: "The Southern Cross"May 12: "A Marvel Television Special Presentation: The Punisher: One Last Kill" What time do Daredevil: Born Again episodes come out? Lili Taylor, Vincent D'Onofrio and Ayelet Zurer in 'Daredevil: Born Again.'. Jojo Whilden/Marvel New episodes of Daredevil: Born Again season 2 will be released weekly at 6 p.m. PT. While you're waiting for new episodes, there is also a companion video podcast that will dive deeper into season 2. The podcast — which will feature guests from the cast — unpacks each episode as it airs and gives behind-the-scenes details from the season. New episodes of the podcast release weekly alongside the show on Disney+. Where can I watch Daredevil: Born Again? Charlie Cox and Deborah Ann Woll in 'Daredevil: Born Again.'. Courtesy of Marvel Television Daredevil: Born Again season 2 will be available on Disney+, where the first season is available to re-watch.
